For You, Ishaal

Today isn't just another birthday — it's a celebration of someone whose laugh can change the mood of an entire room.

Every conversation, every memory, every random call at the strangest hours — all of it feels special simply because it's you on the other end. A friendship like ours doesn't come easy, and I'll always be grateful I found it.

So today, just this: keep laughing, keep shining, and stay exactly who you are — a little bit chaotic, endlessly genuine, and completely, irreplaceably yourself.

Happy Birthday, Ishaal.

With prayers and endless love, Sheikh Basim
